transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As we all know, we have 3,600 finished motor housings packed at the plant for an overseas customer, the ocean booking was cancelled, and the order is due this week. Rail and dedicated road transport are both available as recovery options, but each requires a new release plan and booking. I'll be making the binding recovery decision, but first we need to go through our normal pre-release process. I need Logistics, Export Compliance, Packaging Engineering, and Customer Fulfillment to each submit their relevant constraint as a formal huddle-record entry. Please go ahead and put your entries on the record so I can review them before signing the plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I confirmed with the carriers this morning that an intermodal rail departure on Tuesday at 06:00 can carry exactly 2,400 units and arrive Thursday at 14:00, while a dedicated road convoy can carry the remaining 1,200 units if it departs Wednesday at 08:00 and arrives Thursday at 18:00. I have not yet entered the replacement bookings because Mara has not approved the recovery mode. This is my formal Logistics huddle-record entry: the carrier capacity and timing constraints are as stated above.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: This is my formal Export Compliance huddle-record entry: My destination-customs review confirmed that this replacement shipment cannot be released without a commercial invoice, a certificate of origin, and a serial-number list. I received the customs broker's written confirmation yesterday, but I have not yet attached it to the shipment file.
